description: This file defines a Java class 'DittoPolicyAssertions' that extends base assertions to provide custom assertions for 'Policy' objects in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes a static method to create assertion instances for policies.

classes.name: DittoPolicyAssertions
classes.description: Provides custom assertion methods for 'Policy' objects, facilitating testing and validation within the Ditto framework.

methods.name: assertThat
methods.description: Creates and returns an assertion object for the given 'Policy'.
